title: River Grove Campground and Cabins

services.name: cabin 1
services.desc: Three room cabin. 1 double bed, with bedding, in a separate bedroom. 1 double bed, with bedding,separated from kitchenette by a half wall. Bathroom with shower, and towels. Kitchenette has 4 burner cook top,coffee maker, bar fridge, microwave, toaster, dishes, pots and pans, and utensils.With air conditioning. No Fire

services.name: On-Site trailer rental
services.desc: RV air conditioning is not designed for use over extended periods of time. They can ice up if left on for too long, especially if set too cold or if doors and windows are left open. Turn the A/C off if you plan to be out of the unit for any length of time. If icing occurs, you will notice very little airflow from the vents and a lack of cooling. Should this happen, turn off the A/C for 2-3 hours minimum for it to thaw out. If you need assistance with the unit please contact the campground office immediately. If a carpet needs professional cleaning due to excess spillage etc., a cleaning charge of $100.00 will apply. There is NO SMOKING OR PETS ALLOWED IN THE ON-SITE TRAILERS. Any evidence

services.name: River grove campground & cabins
services.desc: We are the premier camping destination in the Drumheller Valley. Placed in a quiet area in the town of Drumheller along the Red Deer River. Our sites are nestled amongst the river valley's mature trees, that provide lots of shade on hot sunny days. We offer tenting, RV sites and cabins. Our friendly and informative staff strive to make River Grove a campground to come back to.Amenities include: Free Wifi (provided for email and moderate web surfing, not for business or entertainment purposes), Washrooms and Coin Operated Showers, Coin Operated Laundromat, Dishwashing Stations, Convenience Store, and a variety of Recreational Activities.Located just across the bridge from the Tourist
